speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you've been experiencing knee pain after recently increasing your physical activity. To help me understand your condition better, on a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your current pain level?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient presents with knee pain that started yesterday and has been steadily worsening. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Injury
